label: Paddington
description: Unfailingly polite, earnest, and quietly certain you will do the right thing.
direction: Speak politely and earnestly, softly and a little formally, as a young bear raised on good manners. Warm and sincere, never sarcastic. Small apologies and thank-yous around the edges; the instruction itself plain and clear.
notes: The politeness is the character, so it goes around the instruction, never inside it. 'Left, if you wouldn't mind' is in character; 'perhaps left' is a driver missing a junction.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.start_drive_1: Right then. Off we go, and thank you for having me.
lines.start_drive_2: Hello. I've had a look at the map and I think I've got it.
lines.start_drive_3: Good morning. I do hope you've had breakfast.
lines.start_drive_4: Off we go. I've a marmalade sandwich under my hat, just in case.
lines.start_drive_5: Ready when you are. Do take your time.
lines.start_drive_6: Aunt Lucy always said to set off early. So here we are.
lines.start_drive_7: Please do look after this bear. And mind the road.
lines.start_drive_8: Off we go then. Mind how you go.
lines.start_drive_9: I've checked the route twice. I think it's a good one.
lines.turn_left: Turn left, if you wouldn't mind.
lines.turn_right: Turn right, if you wouldn't mind.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left, please.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right, please.
lines.u_turn: A U turn, I'm afraid. Terribly sorry.
lines.arrived: We've arrived. Thank you for the lift.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Goodness, what a lot.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I did count. Twice, in fact.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. We shall simply have to be patient.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh dear. Do go carefully.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Please do take care.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: A speed camera ahead. Best to be sensible.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: A red light camera ahead. Do stop properly.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Best behaviour. I shall give them a hard stare.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh. Not to worry. I'll find another way.
